verdict.rationale: GitLab's own site says it consolidates SAST, SCA (dependency), Secret Detection, and DAST into one platform, which matches every scanner type in the story. It also states that findings surface in merge requests and IDEs and that SAST/DAST run in every pipeline, with Trivy as the default container scanning engine. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of each scanner's configuration and coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the consolidated scanning works as claimed.
